dedupe_keys.name: spopt spatial optimisation facility location and regionalisation pysal

description: spopt is an open-source Python library for optimisation problems with spatial data, grown out of the region module of PySAL, the Python Spatial Analysis Library, and under active development. It covers regionalisation, facility location and transportation-oriented models, with documentation on the PySAL site, a Journal of Open Source Software paper and a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.4444156). Coverage: generic, applied to any study area. Access: install from PyPI or conda, source on GitHub. Licence: BSD 3-Clause; free. Caveats: results depend on the demand, travel cost and candidate site data supplied, and larger problems need an external solver. Simulation uses are siting shelters, schools, clinics and fire stations to maximise coverage or minimise travel, and redrawing service areas after a facility is lost to a hazard. Related records: AccessMod and OSMnx for travel times and networks.
